# JAPANIST

> A specialized Japanese language school offering customized one-on-one tutoring with native Japanese teachers across multiple locations.

JAPANIST (株式會社FTR) provides personalized Japanese language education through online and in-person lessons, serving learners from beginners to advanced proficiency levels. The school offers diverse course types including conversation, business Japanese, JLPT preparation, kids' programs, and cultural studies, with a strong emphasis on native teacher instruction and student success.

## Core Courses

- [Course Overview](https://japanese-specialist.com/japanese-course): JAPANIST course overview: beginner, conversation, kids, business, JLPT, culture
- [Beginner Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/beginner-course): Conversation-focused Japanese for absolute beginners
- [Conversational Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/conversational-course): Daily conversation and communication skills practice
- [Business Japanese Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/japanese-business-course): Corporate training and professional development
- [JLPT Preparation Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/jlpt-course): Japanese language proficiency test exam preparation
- [Kids Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/kids-course): Japanese language learning for children and families
- [Japanese Culture Course](https://japanese-specialist.com/japanese-culture-course): Japanese history, arts, etiquette, and cultural learning
